historical_semantics: Historical U5=U1 fixed real-only OOF scoring + U2; historical U5_F1 adds frozen flow gate. New user U5=U2 has no OOF. Historical rows are not renamed.
new_control: Use each cell canonical U2 parameters and group alpha; reuse actual retained auto/CUDA-trained F1 weights and historical locked tau; fixed-round A/B/C require fresh common schedule, not historical end-to-end U5 predictions.
observed_difference_mechanism: Same integer seeds do not ensure matched anchor streams: OOF vs refreshed in-sample true-label scores change ranking/difficulty and allocations; independent inner AP searches can select different native parameters/group alpha. F1 rejection changes training counts, refit trajectory and predictions.
outer_role_conversion: Outer generator training includes former inner validation AFTER inner-only mask selection; no active heldout validation at final outer stage. Explicitly disclose this role conversion.
user_selected_count_policy: Round count columns in ALL arms with np.rint ties-even after raw numeric finite/nonnegative and BounceRates/ExitRates/SpecialDay<=1 checks, then count0=>duration0 and observed real-TRAIN category checks before F1. No negative-to-zero rescue, observed-max bounds, clipping, or invented Bounce<=Exit. A differs from historical continuous coordinates while retaining original proposal math/params, native anchors/quotas, frozen F1.
